name: Claude Code Full Course 2026 | How Senior Engineers Actually Build with AI

segments.text: This is Claude Code refusing to read my environment file because I told it that it's never allowed to.
This is it laying out its entire database plan and waiting for my approval before it writes a single line of code.
And this is it splitting one big investigation across five parallel agents because I asked it to.
If your entire Claude Code experience so far is typing something like build this feature and then hitting enter,
you're using maybe 10% of what this tool allows you to do.
So let me ask you this. Do you really know when to use skills,
sub-agents, project rules, plan mode, permissions, and all the other parts of Claude Code that decide how your agent actually works?
Because if your answer to some of these is no,
then yes, there is still quite a lot to learn.
